mentions.name: Bookshelf Book Club
mentions.description: A shared bookshelf website for a small 2026 book club of six application-only members, each reading sixty self-selected books over the year (five per month). The bookshelf interface is heavily inspired by Stripe Press and supports browsing by swiping left/right on mobile or up/down arrow keys on desktop.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m kicking off my 2026 book club! It’s probably a bit different from book clubs you’re familiar with.

Each of us is reading sixty books over 2026, five a month, where every book is self selected by each member.

It’s small, six people, all brought in by application only.

You can check out our shared bookshelf here! (Heavy inspiration from Stripe Press)
